objective: Require AWG formal specifications and checks to declare evidence class, finite bounds, assumptions, non-claims, and limitations without presenting a model check as implementation proof.
assumptions: AWQ-FORMAL-001 remains owned by Agent Workflow Quality
AWG product checks remain repository-local and deterministic
unknowns: Formal-model strength and implementation refinement require separate review
invariants: A formal result names its method and checked properties
Bounded-model evidence declares finite scope and limitations
AWQ evidence is separate from oracle approval and implementation evidence
A passing model check never implies implementation correctness
acceptance_predicates: The product selects the upstream formal-evidence profile
The lock contains AWQ-FORMAL-001 at the pinned registry digest
Missing evidence class or limitations fails quality validation
A model pass with an implementation proof claim is rejected

formalization.checker: tools/check_spec.py plus pinned AWQ formal-evidence profile
